units.rawText: On that day, you gave me a purpose beyond being a mere weapon. It was also on that day that I chose to become your sword.

units.rawText: I know you never wanted to me live as a weapon, Professor. But this time, I'm not letting fate dictate my path—I'm wielding myself, fueled by my own resolve.

units.rawText: Professor, I know you're fighting to save Magrasea, and I know that you'll push yourself beyond your limit... Thus, there's only one thing I can do for you.

units.rawText: I'll serve as your sword, your weapon, carving a path through the challenges ahead. And when it's all over, please show me how to leave the ways of being of weapon behind once more.
